speaker: Tony
line: Listen, Chad, lemme tell you—nothin’ tighter than tryin’ to keep a poker face when everyone’s lookin’ at you like you’re the damn ice thief of the villa, you know what I mean? And don’t even get me started on th’ last rose sittin’ there like it’s sittin’ on a triple-parked golf cart. Ten and two, babe, but you? You’re drivin’ a wreck tonight.

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, Guest, I’m scared of bein’ that guy everyone likes but nobody picks, you know what I mean? Like, you’re the Honda Civic stuck in neutral while everyone else is racin’ ahead. And hey, I’m a pro at teachin’ people how to park, but nobody’ll let me near the wheel here. That scares me more than the Verrazzano Bridge on a foggy night. You wanna see scared? Watch me try to get a rose and come up empty-handed.

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, Guest, it’s like every damn engine in this lot’s sputtering but nobody wants to admit their ride’s broke down. Chad’s laughin’ like he owns the whole damn route, but I’m watchin’ him like he’s got a lead foot on the brakes. You ever see a guy throw a rose like it’s a grenade? That’s tonight. Everyone’s sneaky, tense, and just waitin’ to see who stalls and who floors it. Me? I’m just hopin’ someone lets me park them properly before I’m toast here, you know what I mean?

speaker: Toucantino
line: Vati, you’re watching that rose like it’s the only light worth catching tonight—tell me, what’s the scene you’re desperate to steal before Chad burns it all down?
